caption: The drawing consists of two triangular shapes placed adjacent to each other, divided diagonally from the bottom left to the top right. Both triangles contain intricate geometric and repetitive patterns, primarily in blue, red, and white. The upper left triangle has a solid blue background with vertical bands and lines in white, forming grid and comb-like shapes along two sides and interspersed throughout, as well as a central field filled with a pattern of small, alternating red and white star or cross shapes. The lower right triangle has a cream-colored background and repeats a similar set of patterns to the upper left triangle, but the motifs are rendered in red and blue ink outlines with sections left open and filled with dotted lines, creating a lighter composition. Both triangles have a border with a fringe detail at the triangle’s bases and along the outer edges. The artist's signature “J. Howard Iams 1937” is written in the lower right corner.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
